moves.name: Forward Tilt
moves.notes: all angles have the same stats

moves.name: Blaster
moves.notes: repeating shots come out every 10 frames. lasers last 34 frames

moves.name: Fox Illusion
moves.notes: shorten frames: 20-21 for shortest, 22 for middle, 23 for longest. can grab edge frame 29

moves.name: Fox Illusion (Air)
moves.notes: shorten frames: 20-21 for shortest, 22 for middle, 23 for longest. can grab edge frame 29

moves.name: Fire Fox
moves.notes: 7 hits frames 20-32 of 2% each, then strong hit frames 43-72. direction based on aim at frame 42. can grab edge before moving as early as frame 16. can grab edge after moving once hitbox is inactive. 3 frames LFS lag

moves.name: Fire Fox (Air)
moves.notes: 7 hits frames 20-32 of 2% each, then strong hit frames 43-72. direction based on aim at frame 42. can grab edge before moving as early as frame 16. can grab edge after moving once hitbox is inactive. 3 frames LFS lag

moves.name: Reflector
moves.notes: able to be jump cancelled frames 4-21. reflects frames 4 to release+1. when landed, fox is in 5 frames of hitlag. normally has 19 frames endlag

moves.name: Reflector (Air)
moves.notes: able to be jump cancelled frames 4-21. reflects frames 4 to release+1. when landed, fox is in 5 frames of hitlag. normally has 19 frames endlag
